backdrop-adjust.label: Backdrop Adjust (native-only; engine-owned pipeline)
backdrop-adjust.note: Native-only: the adjustment backdrop kinds (levels, curves, brightness-contrast, hue-saturation, color-balance, vibrance, invert, desaturate, gradient-map, channel-mixer; docs/design/adjustment-layers.md), one pass over a backdrop split's copied region with moda-color's lookup tables. Hand-authored; the engine owns the pipeline (moda-engine backdrop/exec.rs).

backdrop-filter.label: Backdrop Filter (native-only; engine-owned pipeline)
backdrop-filter.note: Native-only: the backdrop filter kinds grain, vignette, glaze, displace and grade (live-nodes stage 7b), one pass over a backdrop split's copied region. Hand-authored; the engine owns the pipeline (moda-engine backdrop/exec.rs).

layer-blur-composite.label: Layer Blur Composite (ENG-3723, native-only; engine-owned pipeline)
layer-blur-composite.note: Native-only (ENG-3723): layer blur has no TS implementation, so this module is not captured from a production assembler — the canonical source is tools/extract-wgsl/native/layer-blur-composite.wgsl, emitted verbatim. The engine owns the pipeline (moda-engine layer_blur/exec.rs), like shape-solid.

layer-filter-noise.label: Layer Filter Noise (native-only; engine-owned pipeline)
layer-filter-noise.note: Native-only: Figma noise effect (mono / duo / multi integer-hash cells) over a layer-filter capture. Hand-authored; the engine owns the pipeline (moda-engine layer_blur/exec.rs).

layer-filter-shadow.label: Layer Filter Shadow (native-only; engine-owned pipeline)
layer-filter-shadow.note: Native-only: drop and inner shadows of any shape from its coverage capture (fs_prepare: offset source, fs_composite: tint + knockout / clip) and the feather layer filter (fs_feather_source: hard alpha, fs_feather: the layer scaled by its remapped blur). Hand-authored; the engine owns the pipelines (moda-engine layer_blur/exec.rs).

layer-filter-texture.label: Layer Filter Texture (native-only; engine-owned pipeline)
layer-filter-texture.note: Native-only: Figma texture effect (integer-hash value-noise displacement) over a layer-filter capture. Hand-authored; the engine owns the pipeline (moda-engine layer_blur/exec.rs).

progressive-blur.label: Progressive Blur (native-only; engine-owned pipeline)
progressive-blur.note: Native-only: one direction of a variable-radius separable Gaussian (Figma progressive blur). Hand-authored; the engine owns the pipeline (moda-engine layer_blur/exec.rs).

vector_text.effect_width_units: local canvas px (params.z=blur, params.w=stroke; shader converts px→em via instance fontSizePx) — intentionally differs from MSDF screen-px widths, docs/text/vector-text-architecture.md
vector_text.fallbacks: emoji and unsupported (.notdef) glyphs fall back to MSDF at the node level (WebGPUTextSystem)
